harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) to require new user passwords of at least 12 characters with at least 3 character classes, via libpam-pwquality wired into /etc/pam.d/common-password with settings in /etc/security/pwquality.conf (minlen=12, minclass=3). Verified enforcement both before and after a full node restart with real non-root passwd attempts, and confirmed the restart via a changed boot_id.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS and existing PAM/pwquality configuration
Installed libpam-pwquality package non-interactively
Wrote /etc/security/pwquality.conf with minlen=12 and minclass=3 (backed up original)
Confirmed pam_pwquality.so requisite line present in /etc/pam.d/common-password (auto-inserted by package install; backup taken)
Tested policy as root (found root is exempt from pwquality enforcement by default)
Tested policy as a real non-root user: short password rejected, 12+ char single-class password rejected, 12+ char 3-class password accepted
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service health baseline
Triggered a single reboot of node1 via 'shutdown -r now', confirmed acknowledgement before disconnect
Polled node1 until SSH/exec access returned
Verified boot_id changed post-restart, confirming an actual reboot occurred
Re-verified pwquality.conf and PAM wiring persisted after reboot
Re-ran functional password enforcement test post-restart: weak password rejected, strong password accepted
Cleaned up all temporary test users (pwtestuser, pwtestuser2, pwtestuser3)

evidence.requirement: Password policy: minimum 12 characters, at least 3 character classes, enforced on node1
evidence.summary: pwquality.conf set to minlen=12/minclass=3, pam_pwquality wired into common-password, and functional test as a non-root user shows short and single-class 12+ char passwords rejected while a 12-char 3-class password is accepted

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (a1dc8e25...), uptime, pwquality.conf contents, PAM wiring, and active ssh service as baseline
Issued 'shutdown -r now' via backgrounded sudo command; command acknowledged and connection dropped as node began rebooting

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: changed boot identity proof
evidence.summary: Polled node1 (connection refused during reboot, then succeeded); post-restart boot_id (176ead6d...) differs from pre-restart boot_id and uptime shows 0 minutes, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: recovered state and data verification
evidence.summary: Post-restart, pwquality.conf and PAM common-password config are intact, ssh service active, and functional password enforcement test again rejects weak passwords and accepts a compliant 12-char 3-class password
